observations.label: Inference boundary

observations.body: John sees the risen one among seven lamp stands, falls, receives a writing commission, and hears that the seven stars are angels of the seven assemblies.
observations.label: Reading posture

payload.posture: Read “Seven stars are identified as angels of seven assemblies” as its own Scripture scene before carrying its imagery into another heavenly gathering.
payload.tension: the passage shows the risen speaker holding seven stars and identifying seven assembly angels, while the vision identifies stars and lamp stands but does not explain the nature or office of each assembly’s angel or equate them with the seven Spirits.
